decisions.reason: As process data archiving/reporting software close to the established offer, it fits the strategic shift to data-driven infrastructure and remains a low-cost option to keep open.
The manhole floor door with integrated safety railing builds on established capabilities and still has niche infrastructure demand, so we keep the option while monitoring demand.
Flow measurement automation and system software aligns with the firm's data-driven direction and its prospects are still uncertain enough to justify keeping the option.
